lyrics:
[intro]
[verse]
The ink is fading on the page
The candlelight begins to sway
A ghost of summer haunts the hall
Where shadows dance against the wall
[chorus]
Oh tell me if the tide still turns
For the distant lamp that always burns
I keep your secret in the glass
And watch the lonely seasons pass
[verse]
Your velvet coat upon the chair
Still holds the scent of winter air
I play the notes we used to know
In rhythms soft and moving slow
[chorus]
Oh tell me if the tide still turns
For the distant lamp that always burns
I keep your secret in the glass
And watch the lonely seasons pass
[bridge]
The harbor bells are ringing thin
A hollow sound of what has been
I cast my hope into the deep
While all the world is lost in sleep
[chorus]
Oh tell me if the tide still turns
For the distant lamp that always burns
I keep your secret in the glass
And watch the lonely seasons pass
[outro]
